tool: --capture-probe (src/MaterialDockerImage/Shell/LayoutProbe.cs; text width now measured by WPF itself, in place, at the window's real DPI)
configurations: English, Cantonese and bilingual at 1440x960, 1200x800 and 960x720 (dark)

kinds.cut: one-line text wider than its box with no ellipsis
kinds.outside: an element past the window edge or a horizontally clipping parent (sideways-scrolling areas excluded)
kinds.ellipsis: text shortened with an ellipsis; deliberate, full text in a tooltip and the accessible name

first.note: Measured with the probe's first version, which also counted rows of sideways-scrolling tables; real overflows were page headers, segmented controls, title-bar search, buttons and several settings rows.

final.note: Zero cut and zero outside across all 11 configurations. The last two cut findings, the .dockerignore tab of the Dockerfile Creator at 1200 and 1440 pixels wide, were a real one-pixel squeeze by the default tab panel; tab strips now use a wrapping panel that always gives each tab its full width.

note: The probed captures show the test host's own containers and images, so they are not published; this summary keeps only interface labels.
